User question: Which of these quick cross-name reads sound right right now?
A.  Nvidia looks stronger than TSM
B.  Crude oil looks stronger than Intel
C.  Apple looks weaker than Nvidia
D.  Tesla looks stronger than Broadcom
E.  Ethereum looks stronger than Apple

Your final answer must be in boxed format only.
Use \boxed{A} for a single option, or \boxed{B, C} for multiple options.
Do not add explanation outside the box.

options.label: B
options.text: Crude oil looks stronger than Intel

cases.why_this_is_a_natural_user_question: This keeps the FutureX-style truth-set format but makes it feel like a normal trading-desk comparison.
